name: Seattle Parks and Recreation Lifeguard
what_you_do: You watch swimmers. You respond to emergencies. You help teach swim skills. This is at city swim beaches and indoor and outdoor pools.
who_can_apply: Seattle Parks summer jobs are open to ages 16 and up (18 and up for some positions). Lifeguards need a current American Red Cross Lifeguarding, First Aid and CPR/AED certification. The Red Cross course requires you to be at least 15 on or before the last class. You must also pass a swim test.
pay_detail: Listed on the Parks summer jobs page as 'starts at $26.92' (the unit is not stated on the page).
duration: Summer-only at beaches and outdoor pools, or year-round at indoor pools
deadline_text: The last posting closed June 16, 2026. The Aquatics page says Temporary/Intermittent Lifeguards are hired year-round, even when no posting is active.
how_to_apply: Get Red Cross certified. Then apply on GovernmentJobs.com when a listing is active, or email an Aquatic Application (or resume and cover letter) to parksaquatics@seattle.gov, or give it to the Aquatic Center Coordinator at any Seattle indoor pool. Hired lifeguards pass a background check, a physical and the NW Lifeguard Test. Call 206-684-4078.
notes: Red Cross certifications last 2 years. The cost of the Red Cross course is not stated on the Parks pages. Seattle Parks is a municipal employer; Washington L&I says state and municipal governments are not subject to Washington's child labor rules (federal rules still apply).
